1. **`src/invoices.js`** — `createInvoice({ customerId, issueDate, lines })` function that:
   - Validates customer exists (CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND)
   - Validates issueDate is YYYY-MM-DD format and a real date (DATE_INVALID)
   - Validates lines array is not empty (NO_LINES)
   - Validates each line has a positive integer qty (QTY_INVALID)
   - Validates each SKU exists (UNKNOWN_SKU)
   - Returns `ok(invoice)` with draft status and full line details (name, unitPrice, vatRate from catalogue)

2. **`src/errors.js`** — Added three new error codes: DATE_INVALID, NO_LINES, QTY_INVALID

3. **`test/invoices.test.js`** — 13 comprehensive tests covering all validation paths and edge cases

All 25 tests pass (including existing tests for money, customers, and catalogue). The implementation respects all house rules: uses fail() for errors, never mutates arguments, validates all inputs, and is ready for money calculations in the next request.
